rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that something has an unusually high or notable degree of a quality.

example.english: The beef noodles at this little shop are remarkably good.
example.traditional: 呢間小店嘅牛肉麵出奇地好食。
example.jyutping: ne1 gaan1 siu2 dim3 ge3 ngau4 juk6 min6 ceot1 kei4 dei6 hou2 sik6

rows.note: Use this at the sentence level when highlighting that an event or fact is surprising or unexpected.

example.english: They remarkably managed to move all the furniture in the house by themselves.
example.traditional: 佢竟然一個人搬晒成屋傢俬。
example.jyutping: keoi5 ging2 jin4 jat1 go3 jan4 bun1 saai3 sing4 uk1 gaa1 si1
